recent_en: 5E Resources recorded several director dealings in September 2026, with Independent Non-Executive Director Siow Chin How acquiring shares in the open market. The company's latest quarter (ended 30 September 2026) saw net profit rise to RM6.53 million on wider margins, with a Johor capacity boost expected ahead.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Siow Chin How acquired a total of 814,400 ordinary shares on 2, 9 and 10 September 2026.
The company's net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 rose to RM6.53 million with wider margins.
The company guided for a capacity boost in Johor.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM22.165 million with a net loss of RM0.397 million, a net margin of -1.8%.
